segmente.text: Price is never the problem. If people say your product is too expensive, it's not about price.
Instead, it's about the value they perceive from it. Do they really want to exchange their hard
earned money with your product? The truth is, they just don't see why it's worth it.
So your job isn't to lower your price. Your job is to raise their understanding and therefore
increase the perceived value. Because when people understand the real value, price becomes
only a detail, not the showstopper.
